name: acetylacetone to dehydro coenzyme F420-0
summary: A 11-step route from acetylacetone to dehydro coenzyme F420-0(3−), ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: 2-phospho-L-lactate transferase
reactions.equation: enolpyruvoyl-2-diphospho-5'-guanosine + 7,8-didemethyl-8-hydroxy-5-deazariboflavin = dehydro coenzyme F420-0 + GMP + H(+)

reactions.name: a guanosine in RNA + methylglyoxal = an N(2)-(1-hydroxy-2-oxopropyl)-guanosine in RNA
reactions.equation: a guanosine in RNA + methylglyoxal = an N(2)-(1-hydroxy-2-oxopropyl)-guanosine in RNA

reactions.name: ethyl acetate hydrolase
reactions.equation: ethyl acetate + H2O = ethanol + acetate + H(+)

reactions.name: 5-methylsulfanyl-2,3-dioxopentyl phosphate + O2 + H2O = 4-methylsulfanyl-2-oxobutanoate...
reactions.equation: 5-methylsulfanyl-2,3-dioxopentyl phosphate + O2 + H2O = 4-methylsulfanyl-2-oxobutanoate + formate + phosphate + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: aldehyde oxygenase (deformylating)
reactions.equation: octadecanal + 2 NADPH + O2 + H(+) = heptadecane + formate + 2 NADP(+) + H2O

reactions.name: 23S rRNA (adenine(2503)-C(8))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: adenosine(2503) in 23S rRNA + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 8-methyladenosine(2503) in 23S rRNA + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine

reactions.name: 23S rRNA (adenine(2503)-C(2))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: adenosine(2503) in 23S rRNA + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2-methyladenosine(2503) in 23S rRNA + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine
